svg.text: Numerical matches are sorted by provenance before interpretation; App FSM status pills carry the empirical reading.
P.1c electron, P.16 Newton G, P.23 bottom, P.24 top,
tension with the DESI DR2 + CMB
Postdiction-consistent, consistent, algebraic, open, pending, and tension rows do not count as in-favor empirical detection evidence; FAIL rows count against.
P.20 is postdiction-consistent conditional on O.5: m_d = m_u phi^phi = 4.716 MeV (+0.33%); P.3 is sensitivity-limited, not resolved. As evidence that phi or
icosahedral structure is special, every phi-formula match is Tier 4 (constant control test v3, NEGATIVE-FRAGILE; App PSC §PSC.9.6).
Sources: Front Matter, Prediction/Postdiction Firewall; Appendix PRG, Prediction Registry;
